live_data.maintenance_attribution: Registration maintenance explicitly selects an active system superuser. Initial first-active-user attribution was corrected with separate AuditLog entries; frozen source snapshots were retained.

operating_boundaries: Legacy operational recipes remain unchanged; creating or editing recipes through old UAT entry points is blocked in favor of the review workflow.
Approval is not publication. A different company-level kitchen manager must approve, then explicitly publish on or after the requested start date.

Production requires reviewed canonical ingredient mapping, a configured shared raw kitchen, real received unexpired lots, and the brand's ready location. No opening stock, automatic approval or physical inventory migration was invented.

The new production command uses recipe-scaled input quantities and explicit actual good output. It does not silently consume existing Takeaway raw stock or convert existing ready/semifinished balances into Company raw lots.
After raw commit, output_pending is durable. Retry that run, not a new request. The Action Center and production list expose pending delivery.

New Restaurant sales freeze their BOM for later returns. Partial returns for legacy bills without a frozen BOM fail closed for manager reconciliation; full voids use original net movements instead of today's recipe.
Reference material costs are not actual production costs. Actual raw-lot cost is recorded on production and remains separated by brand.
